Like classical world models, Company World Models ingest a company’s current state and a proposed intervention, then estimate the resulting state.

item.title: CERN and Mistral sign a statement of intent to establish a strategic partnership
item.description:
📝 TOPIC:Computing CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science CERN and Mistral sign a statement of intent to advance AI for science and strengthen Europe’s scientific and technological capabilities — 15 October, 2026 CERN and Mistral join forces to advance AI for science (Image: CERN / Mistral) CERN, the European Laboratory for Particle Physics, and Mistral, a European developer of large-scale AI models, have signed a statement of intent to establish a long-term strategic partnership focused on developing foundation models for scientific discovery. The partnership brings together CERN’s expertise in fundamental physics, scientific data and large-scale computing with Mistral’s leadership in large-scale model training, leveraging these combined capabilities and resources to advance AI for science on an exceptional scale. This combination of scale and scientific precision provides exceptional conditions for developing and testing AI.
🔗 Read more: https://home.cern/cern-and-mistral-join-forces-to-accelerate-ai-for-science/
